escalation_note: 500-900 dpi tight crops: p9 amount-column strip and p9 date/name strip (to establish the band structure below the header), p10 amount-column strip, then three --value cell crops used as the geometry spot-verification (p9 row 3 -> $500, p9 row 7 -> $294.00, p10 row 5 -> $706.76) and one purpose-cell crop (p10 row 3) to settle the trailing comma in 'Table cover, life savers,'. No legibility dispute arose; the sheet is typed.

9.measure_note: ROTATED landscape sheet: the printed ROW rules are the page's VERTICAL rules, so the row bands are x-bands and the row index INCREASES as x DECREASES (the sheet's top edge is the image's right edge). All 28 vertical rules 9.71..88.91 were detected by rowbands at a constant ~2.94% pitch - nothing was extrapolated. The header row ('Date | Name of Contributor | Address | Amount') is the band [83.65,86.56]; the band above it [86.56,88.91] is the printed top margin strip; row 1 is the first band below the header, which on this sheet is the SHADED grey strip the scan renders (an empty printed row, not an entry - same convention as the 2020 Ulibarri record d0df0309). The AMOUNT column band on the other axis comes from the column rules measured with coverage restricted to the table's own x-extent (7.66 / 43.84 / 83.43 / 93.50); the Date|Name separator did not survive detection and is not declared. Proved with 900 dpi --value crops at row 3 (reproduces $500) and row 7 (reproduces $294.00).

10.measure_note: Same rotated-landscape geometry as p9. All 29 vertical rules 5.50..88.85 detected at a constant ~2.93% pitch; nothing extrapolated. The header row here is TALLER than one pitch - the band [81.74,86.41] (4.67%) - because Form B's first column header 'Date of Expenditure' wraps to two printed lines; [86.41,88.85] is the top margin strip. Row 1 is the shaded grey strip immediately below the header, and unlike Form A this sheet's first ENTRY sits in row 2 (on Form A the filer left the first data line blank, so his first entry is row 3). Column bands measured with coverage restricted to the data area (6.57 / 14.25 / 57.09 / 67.14 / 84.84 / 94.93). Proved with a 900 dpi --value crop at row 5 (reproduces $706.76).

notes: Fully TYPED 2022 3-line form, three pages: p8 cover (October 25 - Nov 1 box ticked, signed 10/24/2022), p9 FORM A contributions, p10 FORM B expenditures - form order and page order agree here. Both schedules are rotated landscape sheets. Neither schedule prints a per-page subtotal; each prints one grand total at the foot ('to line 1 of report' / 'to line 2 of report') and both close to the cent against the cover. Cover line 1 'Totals from Last Report' is a bare dash on all three lines and stays BLANK in the stated-totals cache (zero-glyph ruling), so This Report == Cumulative. No in-kind items are labelled on either schedule. Donor street addresses printed in Form A's Address column are deliberately NOT carried (PRIVACY.md: city/state only).
